metaTitle: Free Kanban boards for people and companies

hero.intro: An open-source Trello alternative, free for everyone: sign up yourself or register your company, create your team's accounts and work on shared boards in real time. Or install it on your own server with a single command.
hero.note: Free for people and companies. No ads, no tracking, no card.
hero.closedNote: Free sign-up on this instance is paused right now. You can still install your own.

ticker: FREE FOR PEOPLE AND COMPANIES ★ YOUR DATA ★ NO ADS ★ NO TRACKING ★ OPEN SOURCE ★ REAL TIME ★ ENGLISH AND SPANISH

features.title: Everything a real Kanban needs. Nothing it doesn't.
features.intro: Made for small teams and for anyone who would rather keep their tools at home.

boards.title: Drag and drop
boards.text: Boards, lists and cards with labels, due dates, checklists, attachments and comments. By mouse or by keyboard.

realtime.title: Real time
realtime.text: What one person moves, everyone else sees instantly. No reloading.

teams.title: Built for teams
teams.text: Per-board roles (owner, editor and viewer), assignees, notifications and due-date reminders.

calendar.title: Search and calendar
calendar.text: Filter by label or person, search everything and move due dates by dragging cards on a calendar.

api.title: REST API
api.text: Personal tokens, read-only or read-write with optional expiry, for your scripts and integrations.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.text: Download it or delete your account from the settings. GDPR built in, light and dark themes.

paths.title: Free in the cloud, or on your own machine.

online.title: Use it free here
online.text: Create an account for yourself or for your company and start in a minute. Free, with no ads and no card. When you want to leave, take your boards with you in a file.
online.point1: Nothing to install, for people and companies
online.point2: Export your data whenever you like
online.point3: The same features as an installed copy
online.closed: Sign-up is paused on this instance right now.

selfHost.title: Host it yourself
selfHost.text: One command on any Linux machine with Docker. Your data never leaves your server, and a wizard creates your admin account.
selfHost.point2: Backups and updates with one script
selfHost.point3: No limits on users or boards

install.title: One command. Three steps.
install.step1Text: It installs Docker if it is missing, downloads orgtable and generates random secrets.
install.step2Text: Create your admin account and name your instance.
install.step3Text: Put a reverse proxy with HTTPS in front and you are done. The guide covers Caddy and nginx step by step.
install.requirements: You need Linux, Docker Compose v2 and about 1 GB of RAM.
install.copyFailed: Select the command and copy it by hand.
install.readFirst: Rather read it before running it? Good call: <link>install.sh</link> is short.

teams.title: Your company gets its own address.
teams.intro: Register your organization, create your employees' accounts and give each one a role. Every board lives at an address you can share.
teams.urlLabel: Example address of a company board
teams.owner: Owner: the organization's name, address, admins and deletion.
teams.admin: Admin: creates and removes members and manages every board.
teams.member: Member: works on the boards shared with the organization.
teams.private: Private boards stay between their members and the organization's admins. Each organization only sees its own data.
